title: goniopteris juruensis
intro: Goniopteris juruensis, commonly known as the Juru fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is native to the Andes mountain range in South America and is used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Goniopteris juruensis include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to help reduce inflammation and improve immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as having therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
